statements.answer_quote: a 50/50 mixture of antifreeze (ethylene glycol) and distilled water
statements.statement: The normally specified coolant for the HMMWV (M998-series) engine cooling system is a 50/50 mixture of ethylene-glycol antifreeze and distilled water.

statements.answer_quote: This mixture provides optimal cooling performance
statements.statement: Under normal operating conditions, this 50/50 mixture provides optimal cooling performance in the HMMWV (M998-series) engine cooling system.
Under normal operating conditions, this 50/50 mixture prevents freezing in the HMMWV (M998-series) engine cooling system.

statements.answer_quote: protects the engine from overheating under normal operating conditions
statements.statement: Under normal operating conditions, this 50/50 mixture protects the HMMWV (M998-series) engine from overheating.
